description: This file defines the LeaveRequestDao class, an integral component of the OrangeHRM system responsible for data access operations related to leave requests, leaves, and entitlements. It includes methods for saving requests, changing leave statuses, fetching overlapping leaves, and filtering leave data, thus encapsulating the database interactions for leave management within the system.

classes.name: LeaveRequestDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for managing leave requests and related leave entities, providing methods for CRUD operations, querying, and filtering leave data within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: saveLeaveRequest
methods.description: Persists a new leave request along with linked leave records and entitlements, handling transaction management to ensure data consistency.

methods.name: saveLeaveRequestComment
methods.description: Stores a comment related to a leave request, setting creation timestamp if absent.

methods.name: saveLeave
methods.description: Persists a leave entity to the database.

methods.name: changeLeaveStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a leave and manages associated entitlement adjustments, optionally removing linked entitlement records.

methods.name: getOverlappingLeave
methods.description: Retrieves leave records that overlap with a specified date range for a given employee, considering partial day overlaps.

methods.name: getTotalLeaveDuration
methods.description: Calculates total leave hours taken by an employee on a specific date, considering only certain leave statuses.

methods.name: getLeaveById
methods.description: Fetches a leave record by its identifier.

methods.name: markApprovedLeaveAsTaken
methods.description: Converts approved leaves to 'taken' status if the leave date has passed.

methods.name: _markApprovedLeaveAsTaken
methods.description: Private method that performs the actual update of leave statuses to 'taken' for past approved leaves.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestsByEmpNumberAndDateRange
methods.description: Retrieves leave requests for an employee filtered by optional date range.

methods.name: getLeavesByEmpNumberAndDates
methods.description: Fetches leaves for an employee on specific dates.

methods.name: getLeaveRequests
methods.description: Retrieves leave requests based on filter parameters, marking approved leaves as taken beforehand.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestsCount
methods.description: Returns count of leave requests matching filter parameters.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestsPaginator
methods.description: Creates a paginated query for leave requests based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getLeaves
methods.description: Fetches leave records according to filter parameters, with prior status update.

methods.name: getLeavesCount
methods.description: Counts leave records matching filter criteria.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestsByLeaveRequestIds
methods.description: Fetches leave requests identified by a list of IDs.

methods.name: getLeavesByLeaveRequestIds
methods.description: Retrieves leave records linked to specified leave request IDs.

methods.name: getAllLeaveStatuses
methods.description: Returns all possible statuses for leave.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestById
methods.description: Retrieves a specific leave request by its ID.

methods.name: getLeavesByLeaveRequestId
methods.description: Fetches all leaves associated with a specific leave request.

methods.name: getEmployeeLeaves
methods.description: Retrieves leave records for an employee based on filter parameters, marking approved leaves as taken.

methods.name: getEmployeeLeavesPaginator
methods.description: Creates paginated query for employee leave records.

methods.name: getEmployeeLeavesCount
methods.description: Returns the count of employee leaves based on filters.

methods.name: getUsedLeaveTypeIdsByEmployee
methods.description: Fetches distinct leave type IDs used by an employee within an optional date range.
